item.title: KTA Crashes 37% After Whale Wallet Dump
item.summary: KTA fell sharply after a newly created cryptocurrency wallet transferred millions of tokens through cross-chain bridges and subsequently sold the assets for Ethereum, triggering steep declines in both KTA and GALA. The wallet reportedly bridged approximately 9.3 million KTA tokens, valued at about $685,000, along with 2 billion GALA tokens worth roughly $3 million.
